integrity: The lower bound is exhaustive over every rank-3 multiset of nonzero columns of total length at most 9. The upper bound is an explicit length-10 matrix whose 252 request multisets have machine-checked disjoint recovery certificates. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Finite exact result only for binary dimension 3 with five all-symbol requests; it does not extrapolate to other dimensions, request counts, or alphabets. Residual originality risk remains for unindexed older work under disjoint-repair-group or availability terminology.
scientific_claim: Over \(\mathbb F_2\), the exact minimum lengths for five-request all-symbol PIR and all-symbol batch codes of dimension \(3\) are both \(10\): \(\operatorname{ASP}(3,5,2)=\operatorname{ASB}(3,5,2)=10\). A length-\(10\) witness has column multiplicities \((0,1,1,2,2,2,2)\) on the seven nonzero vectors of \(\mathbb F_2^3\), and no rank-\(3\) binary generator multiset of length at most \(9\) satisfies the five-all-symbol PIR property.
title: Exact binary dimension-three five-request all-symbol lengths
